title: Improve time display in thin vertical panels
line: In a thin vertical panel the clock now shows hours and minutes stacked in large digits instead of a tiny one-line time.
explanation: In a vertical panel the Digital Clock always put the whole time on one line and shrank the font until it fit the panel's width, so at the default thickness it was a few pixels tall, worse with AM/PM or seconds. Now, when the panel is narrower than half the width of the one-line time at its full font size, the clock uses a stacked format: hours, minutes, seconds (if shown) and AM/PM each on their own line, sized to the panel width. Wide vertical panels and horizontal panels keep the one-line time.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: stack hours and minutes in thin vertical panels

In a thin vertical panel the time had to fit on one line, so it shrank
to a barely readable size. When the panel is too thin to show the time
at half its full size, now show hours, minutes and AM/PM on own lines.

BUG: 440096
